title: About Us - Inserts Hub
description: Learn about Inserts Hub, a wholesale supplier of custom packaging inserts for businesses of every size.
bodyHtml:
Welcome to Inserts Hub, your trusted partner for high-quality, custom packaging inserts. We specialize in providing a wide range of inserts designed to protect, organize, and enhance the presentation of your products. With a focus on wholesale solutions, we cater to businesses of all sizes, delivering precision-crafted inserts that meet the unique needs of each client.

Our Mission

At Inserts Hub, our mission is simple: to offer reliable and tailored packaging solutions that keep your products safe and looking great. We understand the importance of packaging in creating a memorable unboxing experience, and we strive to deliver inserts that are as functional as they are visually appealing. Whether you need foam inserts for fragile items or custom cardboard dividers for neatly organizing products, we’ve got you covered.

Why Choose Us?

  • Extensive Product Range: From custom foam inserts and cupcake box inserts to candle box inserts and mailer box inserts, we offer a diverse selection to suit various packaging needs.
  • Quality Assurance: We believe in quality that you can trust. Our inserts are made using premium materials and undergo strict quality checks to ensure durability and performance.
  • Competitive Wholesale Pricing: As a wholesale supplier, we offer competitive pricing on bulk orders, making it easier for businesses to access affordable and high-quality packaging solutions.
  • Custom Solutions: Need a specific design or size? Our team is ready to create custom inserts that fit your products perfectly, ensuring a seamless fit and professional look.

Our Commitment to Excellence

With years of experience in the packaging industry, we are committed to providing top-notch service to every client. From the moment you place an order to the time your inserts are delivered, we prioritize clear communication, fast turnaround times, and a hassle-free experience. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we are dedicated to helping your products shine.

Let’s Grow Together

At Inserts Hub, we believe that great packaging starts with the right insert. Let us be your partner in creating packaging solutions that enhance your brand and delight your customers. Whether you're a small business looking for custom solutions or a large-scale enterprise in need of bulk orders, we are here to support your growth.

title: Privacy Policy - Inserts Hub
description: How Inserts Hub collects, uses and protects the information you share with us.
bodyHtml:
At Inserts Hub, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy outlines the types of information we collect from our customers and visitors to our website, how we use this information, and the steps we take to ensure that your information is kept safe and secure.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information when you use our website or services:

  • Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, company name, shipping address, and payment details when you place an order or request a quote.
  • Non-Personal Information: Browser type, IP address, referring/exit pages, and other technical information collected automatically when you visit our website.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information for the following purposes:

  • To Process Orders: To fulfill and deliver your orders, manage payments, and provide customer support.
  • To Improve Our Services: To better understand your needs, improve our website and services, and develop new features.
  • To Communicate with You: To send updates, promotional offers, and information about our products and services, with your consent. You can opt-out of these communications at any time.
  • For Security Purposes: To protect our website and services from fraud and other security risks.

3. Information Sharing

We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personal information to outside parties, except:

  • Service Providers: We may share information with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our website, processing payments, or delivering orders. These providers are required to keep your information confidential.
  • Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information when required by law or to protect our rights, safety, or property.

4. Data Security

We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, please note that no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience. Cookies help us understand how you use our site and improve its functionality. You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, but this may affect your ability to use some features of our site.

6. Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access and Update Your Information: You can request access to or correction of the personal information we hold about you.
  • Opt-Out of Marketing Communications: You can unsubscribe from promotional emails at any time by following the instructions provided in the email.
  • Request Data Deletion: You can request that we delete your personal information, subject to certain legal obligations.

7. Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of these sites. We encourage you to review the privacy policies of any third-party websites you visit.

8. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Any changes will be posted on this page, and we encourage you to review it regularly.

title: Refund and Returns Policy - Inserts Hub
description: Read the Inserts Hub refund and returns policy for custom packaging insert orders.
bodyHtml:
Return and Refund Policy

At Inserts Hub, we stand behind the quality of our packaging inserts and accessories. If you’re not satisfied with your order, please read the policy below for guidance on returns, exchanges, and refunds.

Eligibility

This return policy is valid for all orders placed and shipped within the United States.

Returns

We accept returns for both defective and non-defective products under the following conditions:

  • The product must be unused, in new condition, and returned in its original packaging.

  • A return request must be submitted within 10 days of receiving your order.

  • Returns are accepted by mail only. We do not allow drop-offs or in-person returns.

  • A return shipping label is included in the package.

  • No restocking fees are charged.

To initiate a return, please email us at info@insertshub.com with your order number, reason for return, and any supporting images if applicable.

Exchanges

We accept exchanges for both defective and non-defective products, provided they meet our return conditions. Replacements are shipped once the original item is received and approved.

Refunds

After we receive and inspect your return:

  • Refunds are issued within 10 business days.

  • Refunds will be made to your original payment method.

  • Refunds are processed in USD.

Non-Returnable Items

Please note, we do not accept returns for:

  • Custom-printed or custom-sized inserts (unless defective)

  • Used items or items damaged by the customer

  • Orders returned after the 10-day period

Contact Us

If you have any questions or need help with a return:

📧 Email: info@insertshub.com
📞 Phone: +1-929-2141-874
📍 Address: 3409 N 7th Ave Unit #529, Phoenix, AZ 85013, United States
